election.eligibility: Member corporations in good standing (pass T-1 + T-2 at vote time) may stand and vote.

rules: The Chairman speaks for the group in negotiations and breaks tied alliance votes.
Each member corporation casts exactly 1 vote, naming a member corporation or its CEO.
Votes are cast by Discord DM to hyawii2.0 with a generated ballot (see site) before the deadline.
Most votes wins. A tie triggers a 48-hour runoff between the tied candidates.
A Chairman that falls below T-1 or T-2 mid-term triggers an early election.
